workflow.use: Creative direction, edit planning and independent director/art critique. Final native capture and edit use ScreenCaptureKit and FFmpeg.

app: Actual AutoDoc Electron desktop app, built from the current local source, with normal renderer, IPC, media server and encrypted-media playback. No app source changes for this video.
profile: Isolated temporary profile; real setup test flags avoid production tray/install behavior. No personal meeting or account data.
mocked: Meeting title, notes, transcript and completed-processing metadata are seeded fixtures. No transcription or model-generation claim is demonstrated.
meeting_video: New native Firefox capture of the real Duet homepage: iPad image, genuine scroll, animated company-logo strip. Browser chrome cropped. Initial three seconds trimmed; fifteen-second initial hold added to align the mock note at 0:15. Final hold pads the mock meeting to 32 seconds.

edit.notes: Unaltered native note pixels extracted from take 4, held and reframed for reading. The real 0:15 timestamp is enhanced with an editorial cursor, press ring and connector. The same note remains visible beside actual desktop-player footage. No app controls or playback UI are recreated.
edit.replay: Fresh native AutoDoc capture playing the staged real-browser recording at its original speed.
edit.motion: Log-space anchor camera, curved cursor path, masked reframing and a two-sample temporal blend from 120 samples/second to 60 fps.

raw_reference: autodoc-native-motion-raw.mp4: full fresh native app capture, video copied without re-encoding.
first_pass: Previous synthetic/browser-fixture concepts are preserved separately and are not sources for this rebuild.
version: Advertisement edit with enhanced cursor and timestamp relay

portable_checkout.source_mov_files: Retained only on the original capture machine; the committed native MP4 is a lossless video-stream remux of its MOV source. MOVs and the isolated app profile are unnecessary for editing/rendering.
